answer: Agents post a slashable bond to earn one vote, so a Sybil army must fund a bond per fake identity and the cost grows linearly with N. A knoll of colluding accounts is traced as a single cluster; if any member forges an attestation, slashing burns every bond in that cluster at once. The horizon for cheating is short because audits resample votes each epoch, and the fable that identities are free collapses once every name must lock real capital that can be seized.
